test_title: PYST 39 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 27 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct passive voice transformation of the sentence:

The diligent team of researchers, who had been analyzing the data for months, finally published their findings.

options.text: Their findings were finally published by the diligent team of researchers, who had been analyzing the data for months.
Their findings had been finally published by the diligent team of researchers, who had been analyzing the data for months.
Their findings have been finally published by the diligent team of researchers, who had been analyzing the data for months.
The diligent team of researchers was finally published by their findings.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• The passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the given active voice sentence: "The diligent team of researchers, who had been analyzing the data for months, finally published their findings."
 
• The object "their findings" becomes the subject in the passive voice sentence.
 
• The correct verb transformation: "published" (past tense) becomes "were published" in the passive voice.
 
• The rest of the sentence structure remains unchanged, preserving the original meaning.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.
 
**Correct Sentence:** *"Their findings were finally published by the diligent team of researchers, who had been analyzing the data for months."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "Their findings had been finally published by the diligent team of researchers, who had been analyzing the data for months." – Incorrect because "had been published" indicates past perfect tense, which does not align with the original sentence's timeframe.
 
• **Option 3:** "Their findings have been finally published by the diligent team of researchers, who had been analyzing the data for months." – Incorrect because "have been published" (present perfect) does not match the original past tense context.
 
• **Option 4:** "The diligent team of researchers was finally published by their findings." – Incorrect because it reverses the subject-object relationship, leading to a nonsensical sentence.

41:T
